test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sentences uses the word "desert" with the **same meaning** as in the following sentence? "We had to desert the ship after the engine failed"

options.text: The Mojave Desert is known for its extreme heat.
Many animals that live in the desert are nocturnal.
We found an oasis in the middle of the vast desert.
He would never desert his friends in their time of need.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. He would never desert his friends in their time of need .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, "desert" means to abandon or leave something behind.
 
• The correct answer (Option 4) uses "desert" with the same meaning, referring to abandoning friends during their time of need.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 3 use "desert" with a different meaning, referring to a dry and barren land.

Correct sentence: *He would never desert his friends in their time of need*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Desert as a verb:** To leave someone or something behind, especially in difficult circumstances.
 
• **Desert as a noun:** A dry and barren land with little vegetation.
